metrics.labelled: post hoc; development read; no rollouts; the 20 states shaped this design, so a pass is not evidence on unseen states; changes no earlier verdict; the two mechanisms approved by the user, details not reviewed
metrics.mapping: on arm CPS alone: LOCATOR 5's mapping unchanged, first match: WITHIN BUDGET iff every head has e <= 0.02 m in both layouts; BEATS A TABLE, OVER BUDGET iff every head has e <= T/2 in the new layout; otherwise NO BETTER THAN A TABLE. CP, CS and AP are controls and take labels only as a report
metrics.oracle_kept: simulator camera matrices in every arm
metrics.prediction: CPS BEATS A TABLE, OVER BUDGET, with most of the gain from P; AP also BEATS A TABLE
metrics.states: dev only: N2 main states 4-23, never in training; training on K1-K6 demos 0-39, familiar layout
metrics.written_before: any of this round's training or its read
